subject: Request: One-off POC grant + 60-day evaluation runway - AsterBio
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Samantha Lewis <samantha.lewis@asterbio.com>
Cc: Matt Jenkins <matt.jenkins@asterbio.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: One-off POC grant + 60-day evaluation runway - AsterBio

Team / Samantha —

Quick summary: AsterBio is ready to move to a technical proof-of-concept but ran into a three-week regulatory delay on their side (internal IRB review + data de-ID step). They’ve been very engaged in product sessions and are committed to a two-phase evaluation, but the standard PLG credits (30 days / $5k token allowance) won’t be enough to cover the extra integration work and the longer-run test we’ve agreed.

Ask: I’m requesting exec sign-off for a one-off 60-day evaluation runway and a complimentary token credit uplift of 50k tokens (flat, one-time) to cover the integration re-runs and the downstream inference testing. We will require a short mutual action plan addendum that commits them to weekly checkpoints and a commercial decision meeting at the end of the 60 days.

Why: This is time-sensitive — without the extension they’ll lapse and likely pause evaluation for months. AsterBio is a regulated healthcare prospect (clinical workflows) with a clear path to a paid Dedicated deal if the POC passes the integration and privacy checks. The estimated ARR if they convert is ~ $420k ARR in year 1.

Attachments: mutual action plan v2 (attached). I also attached a snapshot of our SOC2 evidence they requested.

Next steps I propose:
- Approve one-off 60-day runway + 50k complimentary tokens (one time).
- Legal to sign the short MPA addendum (I attached a draft).
- Require AsterBio to confirm data handling and agree to weekly checkpoints (Dev will own SRE/infra touch points).

Appreciate a quick call or thumbs-up — dev and procurement are pressed to get this scheduled.

Best,
Marissa
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0118
[Attachment: AsterBio_MutualActionPlan_v2.pdf (PDF, 120KB)]
[Attachment: SOC2-snapshot-2028-03.zip (ZIP, 2.4MB)]

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samantha Lewis <samantha.lewis@asterbio.com>, Matt Jenkins <matt.jenkins@asterbio.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Mar 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: One-off POC grant + 60-day evaluation runway - AsterBio

Thanks Marissa — good write-up. A couple quick clarifying questions before I sign off:

1) Can you quantify the incremental cost exposure? Break out the 50k token uplift into an estimated $ run-rate for the 60 days (so finance can see the mid-month impact).
2) Are there any product/ops flags we should be aware of (KV cache sizes, unusually long sequences, streaming loads) that would risk SLOs for other tenants?
3) Do we have a legal-lite MPA addendum in place (one-page) or will this route to full legal review? That affects turnaround time.

If the answers are reasonable I’m inclined to approve the uplift and the runway on the condition that:
- We log the uplift as a one-off credit line in the contract with an explicit end date.
- AsterBio agrees to the weekly checkpoint cadence and a commercial decision meeting scheduled for day 55.

Marissa, pls add the estimated $ exposure and cc finance in the follow-up.

-Aditya
Chief Revenue Officer | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai

All — looping in legal_dealdesk@s.redwood.ai for the MPA addendum. From a deal desk standpoint the ask is reasonable given the strategic upside and the regulated nature of the use case. A few practical notes: 

- Finance exposure: 50k tokens = estimated $4,750 incremental across 60 days assuming the current PLG token unit (see attached calc). Please confirm final numbers, Marissa, then I’ll route this to finance for a quick tally and ledger entry.
- Nonstandard term: one-off credit must be recorded as a promotional credit (non-recurring) and flagged in the HubSpot deal so it does not affect future quota calc. I’ll add a note to the deal record.
- Legal: the MPA addendum in the attachment is intentionally short (1 page) to avoid full contract review — but Legal may still want to make edits for data residency language.

If Finance signs the exposure and Legal accepts the addendum with no material edits, Deal Desk recommends approval. We’ll need exec sign-off for the exception to standard PLG limits (60-day runway + token uplift beyond 30-day).

Team / Samantha —

I reviewed the attachments and Lauren’s notes. Finance confirms the estimated exposure (~$4.8k) and Legal has reviewed the one-page MPA addendum with two minor edits (data residency clause tightened, and an explicit non-recurring credit line called out).

Decision (approved):
- One-off 50k token complimentary credit (non-recurring promotional credit) applied to the DL-8421 deal record.
- 60-day evaluation runway starting on contract execution date.
- Weekly checkpoints and a commercial review meeting scheduled for day 55 (calendar invite to follow).
- Require signed MPA addendum and confirmation of data-handling controls before credit applied.

Marissa: please confirm that AsterBio accepts the addendum and we will have Finance issue the credit entry. Dev: coordinate the weekly checkpoints and add the runbook we’ll use to monitor SLOs.

Aditya
